steps: Ask in person. At a mosque or a place of learning you trust, ask who answers questions like yours, and take your question to that scholar with the details of your own situation.

Under the answer of each of the 25 domain tools on the Law, Care, Education, Employment, Science and Religion pages, say what is wrong and the claim is raised from there; against a saved deliverable, raise a claim on the support page. A claim about an answer carries the fingerprint of its text and what served it, never the text itself. A claim is filed as a change that only a person decides, and it stays open until a person answers it; with sign-in off, the Owner answers every claim. This platform is not a regulated provider, so no ombudsman or regulator handles complaints about it.
